intentionalDifferences: Explicit createApplication hook options replace Kit virtual hook discovery.
Svelte getNavigation context replaces $app/navigation; preload attributes use data-velveteen-.
Native request event signal and Bun-backed cookies supplement Web primitives.
Data uses same-URL Accept negotiation and inert devalue promise frames.
Reference production uses actual adapter-node output because pinned upstream documents Vite preview streaming buffering.
Enhanced forms share the page data protocol and full post-action load lifecycle; no separate action wire format.
Remote definitions are explicit host allowlists with validation and typed browser clients; experimental compiler-transformed remote modules remain in the owned unimplemented inventory.

Pinned Kit respond.js disables CSRF checks under __SVELTEKIT_DEV__; Velveteen requires same-origin forms in both development and production. G01-errors asserts reference development 200 with executed action, and candidate development plus both production targets 403 without action output.
